svg.title: ESP-Drone Python tuner GUI — the tuner window
svg.desc: The Drone Tuner window: the Link panel with the UDP / BLE / SPP transport picker, one address box (UDP host, BLE name or SPP MAC), a Devices… button that opens the Bluetooth device list, and Reconnect. The device list is shown open: BLE advertisers (or paired SPP devices) with name, address and signal, drone names first — picking a row connects to that exact device. Also the Gains panel, the Drone buttons and telemetry settings, the Motor test panel with a Run and Stop pair per motor plus a Run all button, the Auto-tune panel with the method dropdown and Model button, and the five live charts on the right.
svg.text: Bench tool · tools/pid-tune/tuner_gui.py · tkinter + matplotlib · run it from a laptop on the drone's network or over Bluetooth (BLE or SPP)
